plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 25% to favor income and stability.
Buy LMT at 5% as a top-quality name to diversify and add stability.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining some.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Buy LMT at 4% to add a quality name and diversify the portfolio.
Buy NVDA at 3% to add a strong tech setup from the scanner.
This plan balances risk and growth, aiming for a more diversified portfolio.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing each to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Buy LMT at 6% and LUNR at 5% to add high-scoring scanner setups.
Buy NVDA at 5% to add another strong tech setup.
This plan stretches for growth, using leverage and concentrating in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and favor income-generating assets.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% to prioritize monthly distributions.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure and align with income focus.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield and reliable income.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on steady monthly distributions. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, favoring income-generating ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
